author: Pallas, 1773
summary: 러시아와 중국에서 번식하고 미얀마 등지에서 겨울을 나는 큰 갈매기로, 우리나라에서는 미조로 이따금 관찰된다. 해안과 강, 하구 같은 습지에서 살며, 염습지 안의 작은 섬에서 번식한다. 죽은 물고기, 곤충, 작은 포유류, 새알, 파충류 등을 먹는다. 몸무게는 0.9~1kg이다.

points.en: white crescents above and below the eye

points.en: yellow bill with red and black bands

art.subject: Pallas's Gull (Ichthyaetus ichthyaetus), adult in breeding plumage, which it acquires in mid to late winter, as seen at Korean estuaries in February–March: jet-black hood over the head and throat, with bold white crescents above and below the eye; neck, underparts and tail white; mantle and upperwings pale grey; outer primaries largely white with a black subterminal band and small white tips; bill heavy, yellow at the base with a black subterminal band and an orange-red tip; dark eye; legs yellow.
art.pose: standing on a mudflat, side view
art.scene: Korean estuary with mudflats where a river meets the sea in late winter (February–March), bare banks and cold light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding (late winter), side view standing: very large bulky build, black hood with white crescents above and below the eye, pale grey back, white primaries with a black subterminal band, heavy yellow bill banded black with a red tip, yellow legs
adult winter, head detail in profile: white head with a dusky mask around and behind the eye, white eye crescents, long sloping forehead, yellow bill with a black band and reddish tip
adult, in flight seen from above, head, body and tail in line: pale grey wings with white outer primaries crossed by a black subterminal band, white tail
art.build: Very large, bulky gull, 60–72cm, among the biggest gulls and much larger than Black-tailed Gull, with a long, sloping forehead, crown peaking behind the eye, and a long, heavy bill drooping slightly at the tip. Legs fairly long, yellow. At rest the long wingtips project well beyond the tail. In flight long wings with white outer primaries crossed near the tip by a black subterminal band, contrasting with the pale grey inner wing.
avoid: Do not paint a dark brown hood or a thin red bill; those belong to small hooded gulls such as Black-headed Gull.
Do not paint black wingtips with small white mirrors like Vega Gull; the outer primaries are mostly white with a black band.
Do not make it small or round-headed; it is huge, with a long sloping forehead and a heavy bill.
